<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="accent" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#9ADB7F"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#6EA95C"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="product" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#BBFFE7"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#86FFCA"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <circle cx="355" cy="17" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#200745" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="351" y1="21" x2="359" y2="13" stroke="#200745" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="367" y="10" width="18" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#200745" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="369" y="12" width="13" height="8" rx="2" fill="#200745"/>
  <rect x="385" y="14" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#200745"/>

  <!-- header -->
  <polyline points="31,57 23,65 31,73" fill="none" stroke="#200745" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <text x="52" y="70" font-family="Poppins" font-size="18" font-weight="600" fill="#200745">Write a review</text>
  <circle cx="355" cy="65" r="18" fill="#F3F0F7"/>
  <line x1="349" y1="65" x2="361" y2="65" stroke="#200745" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  <line x1="355" y1="59" x2="355" y2="71" stroke="#200745" stroke-width="1.8"/>

  <rect x="22" y="97" width="346" height="108" rx="16" fill="#200745" opacity="0.08"/>
  <rect x="22" y="95" width="346" height="108" rx="16" fill="#F7F7F8"/>
  <rect x="38" y="111" width="76" height="76" rx="12" fill="url(#product)"/>

  <polygon points="45,174 63,145 76,158 87,143 107,174" fill="#6EA95C"/>
  <polygon points="45,174 63,151 74,161 86,150 107,174" fill="#A5F59C"/>

  <text x="132" y="150" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#5E6272">Order #KH-28491</text>
  <text x="132" y="176" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#828282">Purchased on Jun 18, 2026</text>

  <!-- rating section -->
  <text x="24" y="244" font-family="Inter" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#200745">How would you rate it?</text>
  <text x="24" y="267" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#5E6272">Your feedback helps the community shop smarter.</text>

  <g fill="#FFDD72" stroke="#FFB83D" stroke-width="1">
    <polygon points="55,285 58,293 67,293 60,298 62,307 55,302 48,307 50,298 43,293 52,293"/>
    <polygon points="126,285 129,293 138,293 131,298 133,307 126,302 119,307 121,298 114,293 123,293"/>
    <polygon points="197,285 200,293 209,293 202,298 204,307 197,302 190,307 192,298 185,293 194,293"/>
    <polygon points="268,285 271,293 280,293 273,298 275,307 268,302 261,307 263,298 256,293 265,293"/>
    <polygon points="339,285 342,293 351,293 344,298 346,307 339,302 332,307 334,298 327,293 336,293"/>
  </g>
  <text x="170" y="330" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#200745">5.0 — Excellent</text>

  <text x="24" y="369" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#200745">Tell us about your experience</text>
  <rect x="22" y="382" width="346" height="156" rx="14" fill="#200745" opacity="0.06"/>
  <rect x="22" y="380" width="346" height="156" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="38" y="410" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#828282">Share what you liked, what could improve,</text>
  <text x="38" y="433" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#828282">and how you use your new product...</text>
  <line x1="38" y1="489" x2="352" y2="489" stroke="#E7E7E7" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="38" y="516" font-family="Inter" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#828282">0 / 500 characters</text>

  <text x="24" y="576" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#200745">Quick highlights</text>
  <rect x="22" y="590" width="104" height="32" rx="16" fill="#F3F0F7"/>
  <text x="74" y="611" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#200745">Great quality</text>
  <rect x="134" y="590" width="104" height="32" rx="16" fill="#F3F0F7"/>
  <text x="186" y="611" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#200745">Fast delivery</text>
  <rect x="246" y="590" width="122" height="32" rx="16" fill="#F3F0F7"/>
  <text x="307" y="611" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#200745">Worth the price</text>

  <!-- action buttons -->
  <g>
    <rect x="22" y="650" width="116" height="48" rx="24" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#200745" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="80" y="680" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#200745">Save draft</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="150" y="650" width="218" height="48" rx="24" fill="url(#accent)"/>
    <text x="259" y="680" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#200745">Submit review</text>
  </g>

  <!-- reassurance -->
  <circle cx="31" cy="730" r="9" fill="#A5F59C"/>
  <polyline points="27,730 30,733 35,727" fill="none" stroke="#200745" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="48" y="735" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#5E6272">Reviews are public and help other Kijiji Hub members.</text>

  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="766" width="390" height="78" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  </g>
  <g>

    <text x="200" y="820" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#200745">Sell</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="274" y="783" width="18" height="14" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <polygon points="279,797 276,802 284,797" fill="#5E6272"/>
    <circle cx="288" cy="786" r="3" fill="#FBA3FF"/>
    <text x="283" y="820" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#5E6272">Messages</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="355" cy="788" r="5" fill="#5E6272"/>
    <ellipse cx="355" cy="800" rx="11" ry="6" fill="#5E6272"/>
    <text x="355" y="820" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#5E6272">Profile</text>
  </g>
  <rect x="165" y="836" width="60" height="4" rx="2" fill="#200745"/>
</svg>
